facts.business: Vodafone Idea Limited is a major Indian telecommunication operator offering Voice, Data, and digital business connectivity services including IoT, Cloud, and Managed Services, operating as a partnership between the Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group.

segments.name: Digital Services (Vi Movies & TV, Vi Games, Vi Shop, Vi Finance, Vi Ads, Utility Bill Pay)
Enterprise/Business Services (IoT, Cloud, Managed Services, Smart Metering)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Committed to sustained customer addition, double-digit revenue growth, and a tripling of Cash EBITDA over the next three years.
Investing Rs 45,000 Cr towards network investments by FY29.

auditor.name: S.R. Batliboi & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The report does not contain any qualification, disclaimer or adverse remarks. The Board reviewed the para i(a)(A) of Annexure 1 regarding certain assets where Company is in the process of updating situation and quantitative information in the records maintained by the Company.

key_risks: Regulatory demands, penalties/fines or increased cost of compliance
Technological changes and competition from new technologies
Dependence on key network and IT equipment suppliers
Network vulnerability to technical failures or natural calamities
Low tariffs globally and need for periodic tariff rationalisation
Relatively lower penetration of 4G/5G subscriber base
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured short term loan from subsidiary companies is repayable on demand on which interest rate is from 6.25% p.a to 6.80% p.a. (March 31, 2025: 7.09% p.a. to 7.37% p.a.).
